purpose: Teach: つぶやく/励む/どうのこうの/苦笑い/こぞって/余程/あたらしい/どことなく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが「綺麗」って小さくつぶやくの聞こえたよ
lines.en: Sho — I heard Mei-sis whisper something so quiet. She said 'pretty.'
lines.style: Soft, observant. Drawn-in, like noticing something small and precious. Gentle certainty in the voice. No performance, just a small discovery shared.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きに励むよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm going to work really hard on my drawing.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Careful weight on the word 'hard.' Not boasting—making a promise to himself and to her. Small voice but steady underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは、どうのこうの言わないでお祖父ちゃんを支えたわ
lines.en: Sho — Mei-sis stood beside Grandpa without needing to say much of anything.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful. Resting on what was done rather than what was said. Tender recognition of something understated but real. Trailing off into the space of what wasn't needed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママの冗談に苦笑いしちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis — I couldn't help but give a wry smile at Mom's joke.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh tucked into the middle. Self-aware, a bit helpless about it. Not hiding the smile, just acknowledging its own awkwardness. Light and honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達がこぞってメイ姉さんに会いたいって言うのよ
lines.en: Sho — All my friends keep saying they want to meet Mei-sis.
lines.style: Pride creeping in at the edges. Not boastful—more like he's noticing and sharing something true. Slight wonder that she matters this much to other people. Warm and a little amazed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんから余程いいお土産もらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Grandpa gave me a really wonderful souvenir.
lines.style: Warm satisfaction. A little luxuriating in the gift itself—not overselling it, just letting it land. Grateful without needing to perform gratitude. Genuine pleasure in the thing and the gesture.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのあたらしいワンピース、可愛いわよ
lines.en: Sho — Mei-sis's new dress is really cute.
lines.style: Straightforward admiration. No hesitation, no awkwardness. Just a fact he noticed and wanted to say. Simple, direct warmth. The comfort of saying true things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんと、どことなく雰囲気が似てるかな
lines.en: Mei-sis — I wonder if Sho and I have kind of the same feeling about us?
lines.style: Curious, gentle. Turning the thought over slowly. Not quite a question, more like wondering aloud to herself. Soft and open. The tenderness of noticing connection without naming it too loud.
